name: Naltrindole
summary: Naltrindole is a highly potent, highly selective delta opioid receptor antagonist used in biomedical research. In May 2012 a paper was published in Nature with the structure of naltrindole in complex with the mouse δ-opioid G-protein coupled receptor, solved by X-ray crystallography.

pharmacology.text: Naltrindole is a highly potent, highly selective delta opioid receptor antagonist used in biomedical research. In May 2012 a paper was published in Nature with the structure of naltrindole in complex with the mouse δ-opioid G-protein coupled receptor, solved by X-ray crystallography.

uses.text: Naltrindole is a highly potent, highly selective delta opioid receptor antagonist used in biomedical research.

fact.en: In 2012 scientists used naltrindole to capture the first detailed three-dimensional picture of the δ-opioid receptor, published in the journal Nature.
fact.zh: 2012 年，科學家利用 naltrindole 取得了 δ 型鴉片受體第一張詳細的立體結構圖，並發表於《自然》期刊。
fact.zhHans: 2012 年，科学家利用 naltrindole 取得了 δ 型鸦片受体第一张详细的立体结构图，并发表于《自然》期刊。
